title: Installing Tailwind CSS in a Frontend Framework knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which principle is most useful when applying Installing Tailwind CSS in a Frontend Framework?
options: It makes every interface responsive and accessible without testing.
It runs all utility classes as JavaScript in the browser.
the installed package and build-tool integration must match the documented workflow
It removes the need to understand HTML semantics, the CSS cascade or browser behavior.
questions.answer_key: the installed package and build-tool integration must match the documented workflow
questions.explanation: Installing Tailwind CSS in a Frontend Framework is best understood through the syllabus topics: Understanding framework-specific integrations, Setting up React applications, Setting up Next.js applications. Choose the technique deliberately and verify the result.

questions.prompt: Which workflow is strongest when working with installing tailwind css in a frontend framework?
options: Skip narrow-screen testing because utility-first CSS is automatically responsive.
follow the official install guide for the current toolchain and verify that the stylesheet is imported
Add classes until a screenshot looks acceptable without inspecting generated CSS.
Assume that starting a development server proves every page and state works.
questions.answer_key: follow the official install guide for the current toolchain and verify that the stylesheet is imported
questions.explanation: A reliable workflow checks generated CSS and the actual interface. Related topics include: Understanding framework-specific integrations, Setting up React applications, Setting up Next.js applications, Setting up Vue and Nuxt applications.

questions.prompt: Which common mistake should you avoid when applying installing tailwind css in a frontend framework?
options: mixing incompatible v3 and v4 setup instructions can prevent styles from compiling
Document intended behavior and test representative content.
Use the official documentation for version-specific behavior.
Check keyboard states where controls are involved.
questions.answer_key: mixing incompatible v3 and v4 setup instructions can prevent styles from compiling
questions.explanation: Good styling work is verified, version-aware and tested with realistic content and input methods.
